loop.reset.prompt: A time loop resetting: a quick reverse rewind swoosh with a soft rising tonal sweep and a gentle low thump at the end, sci-fi, no music, no voice

horizon.cross.prompt: Crossing the event horizon of a black hole: sound stretches and slows, the pitch falls away into a long fading deep drone and then silence, eerie and vast, cinematic, no music, no voice

wormhole.cross.prompt: A spaceship passing through a wormhole: a deep resonant whoosh that rises then collapses with a shimmering bending tonal sweep, cinematic sci-fi, no voice, no music, no melody

wormhole.open.prompt: A wormhole opening in space: a low swelling hum with glassy shimmering harmonics blooming outward and then settling into a calm vibrating glow, cinematic sci-fi, no music, no voice

wormhole.idle.prompt: Continuous ambient hum of a stable wormhole: soft deep glassy resonance with a slow gentle warbling shimmer, seamless loop, no melody, no voice, no music

blackhole.rumble.prompt: Immense distant black hole rumble: an extremely deep sub-bass drone with slow pulsing pressure and faint warped metallic groans, seamless loop, ominous, no melody, no voice, no music

blackhole.birth.prompt: A black hole being born in the sky: a violent tearing rush that collapses into a huge deep sub-bass boom followed by a lingering ominous low drone, cinematic, no music, no voice
